taxonomy.name: Tycho architecture-style scope v1
taxonomy.basis: A style is in scope when it names a structural organization of an application or system, has a technical owner section, admitted public sources and a decision card. Platform products, deployment topologies and single design patterns are not styles unless they change the structural organization.
taxonomy.note: This is the project taxonomy for scope decisions, not a claim to enumerate every published style.

catalog_denominator.reason: Event-Driven Architecture is the only candidate admitted as a new catalog entry in this decision; the denominator changes only after that entry lands.

candidates.action: add catalog entry, owner section, dedicated card and admitted public sources
candidates.rationale: Structural style-level gap; events currently appear only as messaging and consistency mechanisms. Isolated new page avoids editing promoted owner pages.
V08/C03 already carries the chapter treatment; a separate style entry would duplicate it without a structural decision boundary.
Pipes and Filters already owns the structural pattern; a style-level Pipeline entry would duplicate its identity.
Platform and infrastructure concern rather than an application architecture style; covered by Sidecar, Reverse Proxy and API Gateway entries.

candidates.action: no catalog entry until a public source base and owner demand exist
candidates.rationale: No volume corpus and no admitted style-level source; adding a name now would be catalogued-only, not coverage.

candidates.action: no catalog entry until a public source base and owner demand exist
candidates.rationale: Historical, narrow niche with no volume corpus or admitted source; a name-only entry would violate the evidence gate.

non_goals: No exhaustive claim over all published architecture styles.
No style entry without an owner section, admitted public sources and a decision card.
No duplicate style entry for Pipeline while Pipes and Filters owns the pattern.
No platform-product entry for Service Mesh as a style.
